source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: The Solid rule belongs to every dense terrain feature: no line of sight may be traced through an enclosed opening in its surface if the opening is 3" or less above the ground. Designer’s note: models taking cover in terrain at ground level therefore stay unseen despite doors, windows, bullet holes or narrow spaces between neighbouring features; 3" matches a typical first storey, and missions may alter the height used. Gone to ground: a hidden model counts as gone to ground whenever intervening dense terrain stops the attacker seeing all of it and its unit has made no ranged attacks in this turn or the one before; while that lasts, its detection range drops by 3". Designer’s note: a unit that shot in this or the last turn can never go to ground, even with an ability letting it shoot while staying hidden. Example: a window no higher than 3" in a dense feature stops two units seeing each other through it, while gaps higher than 3" do not block sight lines.
